attribution_status.description: How the supplier on this call was established

buyer_code.description: Buyer this call belongs to, held as buyer_code to match how Lead.buyer_id is stored

call_at.description: When the call happened, from the sheet's date column

call_id.description: The call platform's own ID for this call, e.g. Ringba CallId. Primary de-dupe key when present.

call_status.description: Commercial outcome of the call, the equivalent of Lead.final_status. Converted means the call qualified and pays. Rejected means the buyer declined it, normally with a disposition. Error means the row could not be processed. Pending means no outcome yet. Deliberately has NO default: an unset value lets the app derive an outcome from the qualified flag and disposition, whereas a default of Pending would stamp every new call as Pending and suppress that.

caller_id.description: Caller ID number when it differs from the primary number

campaign_name.description: Buyer campaign the call was routed to, e.g. the Campaign column on the call sheet

consumer_state.description: State the consumer called from, which can differ from the incident state held in state

custom_fields.description: JSON object of columns mapped by the operator that have no dedicated field here

dedupe_key.description: Marker used to stop the same sheet row being ingested twice

disposition.description: Main disposition from the buyer, e.g. Did not meet pricing parameters, Already Represented, Outside SOL

dispositions.description: Full semicolon separated disposition list when the buyer returns more than one reason

inquiry_status.description: The platform's own call state, e.g. Call Connected, Assigned Call, Open Call

lead_id.description: Lead record this call was matched to, when the number belongs to a known lead

media_source.description: Trackable media source reported by the call platform

mobile.description: Digits only caller number, used to join calls to leads and to attribution feeds

mobile_raw.description: The number exactly as the sheet held it

qualified.description: Whether this call counts as qualified or converted, decided by the sheet's conversion rule

qualified_raw.description: The raw cell value the qualified decision was made from, kept so the rule is auditable

revenue.description: What this call pays, e.g. partner commission

sid.description: Supplier ID, normally filled by a Ringba attribution sheet matched on the number

source_id.description: LeadSource record this call was read from

source_name.description: Display name of the sheet or feed this call came from

supplier_name.description: Supplier credited with the call, resolved from a matched lead or an attribution feed

unique_inquiry.description: Whether the call platform counted this as a unique inquiry rather than a repeat contact

vertical.description: Law type or vertical, e.g. MVA, WC, Premise

vertical_detail.description: Narrow law type, e.g. Auto PI, Pedestrian, RideShare

web_lead.description: Whether the call platform flagged this inquiry as originating from a web lead
